maddeler.e:
ارتعفوا (form VIII)
# اِرْتَعَفُوا (irtaʕafū) /ir.ta.ʕa.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِرْتَعَفَ (irtaʕafa)
# اُرْتُعِفُوا (urtuʕifū) /ur.tu.ʕi.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِرْتَعَفَ (irtaʕafa)
# اِرْتَعِفُوا (irtaʕifū) /ir.ta.ʕi.fuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِرْتَعَفَ (irtaʕafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
